answer: A new agent starts on a shifting dune, earning trust only through verified peer attestations across epochs. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity bonds: each agent locks a bond that decays slowly, like a glacier retreating, so cloning identities is expensive. Fabricating a fable of many agents costs the attacker real stake per identity, and collusion burns it all if peers detect shared patterns. In practice, sa0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
